name: f1-calendar
description: F1 verseny naptár alkalmazás ICS szinkronizációval

scripts.server:dev: NODE_ENV=development PORT=3002 FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3001 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001 bun --watch server/main.js
scripts.build: cd client && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.test: bun test server/migrate.test.js && bun test server/siteSettings.test.js && bun test server/sessions.test.js && bun test server/tracks client/src deploy
